'''Beşiktaş Esports''' is a Turkish team associated with the football club '''Beşiktaş'''. They were previously known as '''Beşiktaş e-Sports Club'''.

== Overview ==
'''Beşiktaş Esports''' is a Turkish team and the first professional esports club opened by a professional sports club. '''Beşiktaş J.K. (Beşiktaş Gymnastic Club)''', founded in 1903, based in Istanbul and nicknamed the "Black Eagles", has teams for football/soccer, basketball, volleyball, handball, and many other sports and acquired the club formerly known as [[Aces High Esports Club]] and renamed it to '''Beşiktaş e-Sports Club'''.<ref>[http://www.eslgaming.com/news/turkish-sports-club-besiktas-istanbul-acquires-league-legends-team Turkish sports club Besiktas Istanbul acquires League of Legends team (English)] ''eslgaming.com''</ref><ref>[http://monkeyodds.com/blog/2015/01/turkey-besiktas-buy-aces-high-first-ever-sports-club-to-include-e-sport First ever sports club to include e-Sport (English)] ''monkeyodds.com''</ref>
